dashboard.alt: Company directory showing summary counts, batch dates, assessment statuses and action buttons
dashboard.caption: The company directory displays summary counts, batch dates, assessment statuses, and company actions.

add-company.alt: Add company dialog with company name, contact email, login email, description and batch
add-company.caption: The Add company form records company details, permitted Google accounts, and a batch assignment.

company-settings.alt: Company settings dialog showing login emails, description, batch and Save button
company-settings.caption: Company settings contain editable login emails, an internal description, and the batch assignment. Save stores changes.

delete-company.alt: Company deletion confirmation with a permanent deletion warning and Cancel button
delete-company.caption: The confirmation identifies the company and describes permanent deletion. Cancel returns to settings.

batches.alt: Edit batches dialog with start and end month fields for batches one through nine
batches.caption: Batch start and end dates use MM/YYYY. Unscheduled batches can have empty dates.

readiness.alt: Company readiness results with three reporting periods, score table and radar chart
readiness.caption: The admin KTH tab compares six readiness areas across three reporting periods.

readiness.alt: KTH level guide with area tabs, current level marker and requirement answer statuses
readiness.caption: Area tabs display each readiness area’s level requirements and saved company answers.

exports.alt: Company details header with Export XLSX and Export PDF buttons
exports.caption: Company details provide Export XLSX and Export PDF controls. Directory exports are available on the main company list.

maturity.alt: AI maturity results showing stage ratings, comments and a clarification flag
maturity.caption: The admin AI Maturity Test tab displays each stage’s score, comment, and clarification flag.

slack.alt: Slack conversation explorer showing conversation selection, export buttons, a message and its reply
slack.caption: The conversation explorer contains conversation selection, message threads, and conversation archive export controls.

company-sign-in.alt: Company dashboard with KTH readiness and AI maturity cards, progress percentages and assessment buttons
company-sign-in.caption: Registered company accounts open this dashboard. Assessment buttons display Start assessment, Continue assessment, or Edit assessment according to progress.

company-readiness.alt: Editable company KTH guide with readiness area tabs, level selector and Achieved, Not achieved and Not applicable buttons
company-readiness.caption: Company view: area tabs and level numbers select requirements. Each requirement accepts Achieved, Not achieved, or Not applicable.

company-readiness.alt: Company readiness score inputs, radar chart, reporting periods and Submit answers button
company-readiness.caption: The editable score table and radar chart display reporting-period results. Submit answers stores the table scores and guide answers together.

company-readiness.alt: Company level guide help explaining requirement answers, automatic score increases and Submit answers
company-readiness.caption: About the level guide describes requirement answers, automatic score increases, progress, and submission.

company-maturity.alt: Company AI Maturity Test introduction with Start test and assessment export buttons
company-maturity.caption: A new AI maturity assessment displays an introduction and Start test.

company-maturity.alt: Editable company AI maturity stages showing score buttons, comments and clarification controls
company-maturity.caption: Company view: each stage has score buttons, a comment field, and a clarification control. This example shows an assessment reopened after submission.

company-maturity.alt: Submitted company AI maturity assessment showing confirmation and Save changes button
company-maturity.caption: The submitted assessment displays a confirmation and Save changes. Before the first submission, the button is labeled Submit answers.

company-follow-up.alt: Company readiness results with three reporting periods, score table and radar chart
company-follow-up.caption: Admin view: the KTH tab displays the company’s saved reporting-period scores and radar chart.

company-follow-up.alt: AI maturity results showing stage ratings, comments and a clarification flag
company-follow-up.caption: Admin view: submitted AI maturity results include ratings, comments, and Unclear flags.

login.alt: BeScaled Hub login screen showing the Terms of Use agreement and Sign in with Google button
login.caption: The login screen contains the Terms of Use agreement and Google sign-in. Administrator accounts open the company directory after sign-in.
